WGI.Settings.ApiKey.Name: API Key
WGI.Settings.ApiKey.Hint: Click Copy next to Key in Wanderer's Guide (Account > API Clients) and paste it here. Stored only in this browser (client setting).
WGI.Settings.AuthUrl.Name: Auth URL
WGI.Settings.AuthUrl.Hint: Optional. Click Copy next to Auth URL in Wanderer's Guide and paste the whole URL here.
WGI.Settings.WgServer.Name: WG server
WGI.Settings.WgServer.Hint: Production uses wgui.wandersguide.site. Pick Custom to use the URL below.
WGI.Settings.FunctionsUrl.Name: Custom server URL
WGI.Settings.FunctionsUrl.Hint: Only used when WG server is Custom. Base URL of the Wanderer's Guide edge functions. Local dev: http://127.0.0.1:8000/functions/v1
